# Security policy

**Please do not report a security vulnerability in a public issue, a pull request or a forum.**

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report it privately on GitHub, with **[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/webhead-GmbH/searcio/security/advisories/new)** on this repository's Security tab, or email **[support@searcio.com](mailto:support@searcio.com)** with "Security" in the subject line. Please include:

- what is affected: the plugin version, and the screen, REST route, shortcode or block involved;
- the steps to reproduce it, or a proof of concept;
- what an attacker could do with it, as you see it;
- whether you would like to be credited, and under which name.

We confirm that we have received your report, keep you informed while we work on it, and tell you when the fix is released. Please give us a reasonable time to release a fix before you disclose anything about the issue.

## Supported versions

Security fixes go into the latest release. Please update to it before you report.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 1.4.x   | Yes       |
| < 1.4   | No        |

## Scope

This repository is the Searcio plugin for WordPress and WooCommerce. A vulnerability in the Searcio service itself (searcio.com, its API or its dashboard) is welcome at the same address.
